text: Customers may return unused items within 30 days of delivery. Keep the order confirmation to start a return.
Personalized items and perishable goods cannot be returned unless they arrived damaged.
Standard shipping usually takes three to five business days after an order ships.
A tracking link is sent by email when the package leaves the warehouse.
Delivery delays caused by weather may add one or two business days.
Receipts are emailed after payment. Customers can request a copy from support.
Refunds are sent to the original payment method and may take five to ten business days.
A pending card authorization normally disappears within three business days if an order is canceled.
To change an account email address, sign in and open Profile Settings.
Use the password reset link on the sign-in page if you cannot access your account.
Support is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM local time.
Include an order number when contacting support, but never send a password or full payment card number.
Accessories include a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.
Accidental damage and normal wear are not covered by the limited warranty.
An order can be canceled before it enters packing by using the Orders page.
Packed orders cannot be canceled, but eligible items may be returned after delivery.
Account profile data is used to provide and support the requested service.
Customers can request deletion of their account from Profile Settings or by contacting support.
The store accepts major credit cards and supported digital wallets at checkout.
Payment details are processed by the payment provider and are not shown in support replies.
Promotional codes must be entered at checkout and generally cannot be applied after payment.
Customers who need help placing an accessible order can contact support during business hours.
Subscriptions renew on the date shown in account settings. Customers may cancel before renewal.
After cancellation, access remains active until the already-paid subscription period ends.
